story.title: Run the Humboldt Bay waterfront
paragraphs: Humboldt Bay Marathon is a nonprofit affiliate of the Road Runners Club of America with goals to promote fitness, outdoor recreation, and trails in Humboldt County. The 2026 race is listed for August 9, 2026 as the event's 11th running.

The race weekend includes a Marathon, Half Marathon, and 5K. All races start and end at Madaket Plaza at 1st and C Streets in Eureka, with routes built around the Eureka Waterfront Trail, Humboldt Bay Trail, Eureka Boardwalk, Arcata Marsh, and a Klopp Lake loop for the marathon.

The current site emphasizes a community feel: active registration, public results and photos, volunteer opportunities for adults and students, local sponsors, custom medal and shirt artwork by local artist and runner Sara Starr, and local nonprofit Redwood Coast Mountain Bike Association timing support.

volunteer.headline: Help keep Humboldt Bay moving on race weekend
volunteer.description: The race lists volunteer roles for course monitoring and traffic control, start and finish areas, and pre- and post-race setup and tear down. Adult volunteers and student volunteers are both highlighted on the current site.
items: Course monitors help runners and drivers know where to go and assist with traffic signs and barricades.
Start and finish volunteers support food tables, parking information, and runner flow around Madaket Plaza.
Students can receive a certificate acknowledging volunteer hours for this nonprofit event.

faqs.question: Where do the races start and finish?
faqs.answer: All races start and end at Madaket Plaza, 1st and C Streets in Eureka.

faqs.question: What are the listed start times?
faqs.answer: The current event schedule lists the Full Marathon at 7:00 AM, Half Marathon at 8:00 AM, and 5K at 8:20 AM on Sunday, August 9, 2026.

faqs.question: Is packet pickup available before race morning?
faqs.answer: Yes. The current schedule lists Saturday packet pickup from 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM at Madaket Plaza. The distance pages also say packet pickup is available Saturday afternoon and Sunday morning, with details on the Event Schedule page.

faqs.question: What parking information is listed?
faqs.answer: The marathon and half marathon pages list a gravel lot at 1st and D, plus free and unrestricted street parking and city lots on Sundays.

faqs.question: Is gear drop listed?
faqs.answer: Yes. The marathon and half marathon pages say bags will be checked for runners at the start/finish area and waiting when runners finish.

faqs.question: What aid-station support is listed?
faqs.answer: The race information and distance pages list aid stations approximately every 2 miles, with ample bathrooms noted for the marathon route.

faqs.question: Do finishers receive medals and shirts?
faqs.answer: The distance pages say finisher medals are given to participants finishing within the allotted time. The site also highlights custom artwork on medals and shirts, and the half marathon page says registrations received at least two weeks before race date include a race shirt with this year's custom artwork.

faqs.question: Who provides timing support?
faqs.answer: The sponsors section says Redwood Coast Mountain Bike Association provides timing with gun start, chip finish, and at least one split for each distance.

uncertainty.summary: Only current public-site details are rendered. Conflicting or outdated public-page details are kept out of visible UI where possible.
items: The event schedule page says official timing ends at 1:00 PM and the marathon page lists a 6 hour time limit; the race information page also references a maximum of 7 hours for marathon finishers. The visible FAQ uses the distance-page/current schedule phrasing and this conflict is retained here for review.
The marathon shirt cutoff text appears to reference 7/22/2025 on a 2026 page, so the mockup avoids rendering that exact date and uses only the source-backed custom-shirt/artwork language.
Detailed 5K time limit, shirt cutoff, and age-group specifics were not found on a dedicated current 5K page and are intentionally omitted.
